summary: Adecoagro S.A. (NYSE: AGRO) filed Form 6-K announcing its agreement to acquire the Caarap mill from Raízen Group for R$760 million (approx. US$148 million) in cash at closing. The mill processes ~3.5 million tons of sugarcane annually. Adecoagro's VP stated the acquisition aligns with its Cluster strategy in Mato Grosso do Sul, expects Adjusted EBITDA accretion from day one, and sees operational synergies via integration with its Angelica and Ivinhema mills. The transaction is subject to CADE antitrust approval with closing expected before October 1, 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and integration execution.
